discoveries.title: 2026 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections — election day
discoveries.summary: Official COMELEC materials identify November 2, 2026 as the 2026 BSKE election date. This remains an internal Civic Timeline candidate until the Elections domain owns a current 2026 BSKE milestone record.

supportingSources.label: COMELEC 2026 BSKE resolutions index
supportingSources.note: The official index lists Resolution No. 11266 as an August 11, 2026 amendment to the 2026 BSKE calendar; the amended calendar should be reviewed before promoting the full milestone set.

geography.note: National election calendar projected locally only after the Makati Elections canonical owner is ready.

discoveries.reviewerNote: Do not publish directly from this discovery object. First add/resolve the canonical 2026 BSKE milestone set in Elections and reconcile later COMELEC calendar amendments.
